hooks.name: aidlc-plan-approval-guard
hooks.description: Blocks Code Generation before a human-owned Plan Approval receipt, using exact tool targets when available and a source-floor fallback for legacy argument-less payloads.

action.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\aidlc\aidlc-shim.ps1" engine adapter kiro-ide plan-approval-guard
